services.title: Execution of Fire Protection Works
services.description: Professional execution of all types of passive fire protection works to the highest quality standards.
services.fullDescription:
FSB d.o.o. carries out all types of passive fire protection works. Our team of experienced, certified installers ensures that every project is executed to the highest quality standards and in compliance with applicable regulations — because all systems must work as a whole.

Our works execution services include:

- Firestopping of service penetrations
- Application of fire protection paints and coatings to steel structures
- Installation of fire protection cladding and boards
- Installation of fire-rated doors and metalwork — doors, partitions and access panels
- Installation of fire-rated glazing and spandrels

We deliver every project with particular care, from preparation to final inspection and complete documentation, ensuring that our clients receive solutions that fully meet their needs and legal requirements.

services.title: Consulting and Cost Optimization
services.description: Consulting services based on long-standing execution experience — cost optimization and the selection of suitable solutions without compromising safety.
services.fullDescription:
Fire protection costs are a significant item in every construction project, and the biggest problems in practice arise not in the product, but in the system. Drawing on our long-standing execution experience, we provide consulting services aimed at optimizing costs and selecting suitable solutions.

Our consulting services include:

- Review of the planned systems and identification of savings opportunities
- Proposing alternative solutions of equal or better quality
- Optimizing the choice of materials based on the price-performance ratio
- Technical support for all project participants
- Support throughout the entire execution

With our approach, clients regularly achieve significant savings while maintaining the highest level of fire protection and full regulatory compliance.

services.title: FSB Academy
services.description: Training programs for installers, designers and all participants in the fire protection process. Coming soon.
services.fullDescription:
We believe that knowledge is the foundation of safety — educating the market is one of the greatest challenges of passive fire protection. That is why we are launching FSB Academy, a training program intended for all participants in the fire protection process.

FSB Academy, currently in preparation, will offer:

- Practical training for installers on the correct installation of systems
- Seminars on new regulations, standards and technologies
- Workshops on the most common on-site mistakes and how to avoid them
- In-house training tailored to each company's needs

We pass on our knowledge of the systems first-hand — from daily practice on projects and construction sites. The FSB Academy program is currently in preparation; contact us for more information and upcoming dates.
